Intro.FirstBlockTitle: Leading in Providing Knowledge of Traffic Rules and Preparing for the Driving Test
Intro.FirstBlockDescription: Nkotanyi Driving School is a platform dedicated to helping everyone understand and master traffic rules, enhance safe driving practices, and prepare for the driving test to obtain a driver's license.

aboutSection.title: About Us
aboutSection.description: NKOTANYI DRIVING SCHOOL supports individuals with the knowledge, skills, and confidence to become safe drivers. We are dedicated to providing thorough and personalized instruction.
aboutSection.feature1: Developing technical skills for vehicle operation
aboutSection.feature2: Focus on professionalism, integrity, and innovation
aboutSection.additionalInfo: Each student is valued and supported throughout their journey to mastering road laws.
aboutSection.teaching: Teaching road laws and vehicle operation
aboutSection.vision: Our vision at NKOTANYI DRIVING SCHOOL is to be the leading provider of driver education, setting benchmarks for excellence and innovation.
aboutSection.futureVisionTitle: We envision a future where every road user has:
aboutSection.futureGoal1: The knowledge, skills, and attitudes to adhere to the highest safety and responsibility standards.
aboutSection.futureGoal2: Continuous improvement of our curriculum with advanced technology
aboutSection.finalGoal: We aim to empower generations of drivers by prioritizing safety, durability, and respect for others.
